_note: Trailer types for Freight Loader, adapted from the Cargo Load Planner app's trailer_types.json (deck heights, deck sizes and rated capacities are typical industry figures). Empty weights and axle positions ('rig') are typical values added for Freight Loader's axle-weight model - enter your own under Truck & Trailer. In preference order: the planner uses the first type that carries a piece legally. deck_length_in / deck_width_in / cargo_height_in are the usable cargo space; on open-deck types cargo_height_in is the legal cargo height (13'6" minus the deck height) and pieces may overhang it (oversize, permit needed). Step-decks are modelled as one deck at the main-deck height; lowboy / RGN as the well only, measured from its front (kingpin_in 0). The multi-axle heavy-haul RGN from the Cargo app is left out: it doesn't fit the tractor + tandem axle model yet.

trailerTypes.name: 53' Dry Van
trailerTypes.description: Enclosed box trailer. Freight must fit inside: no oversize.

trailerTypes.name: 48' Flatbed
trailerTypes.description: Most common open-deck trailer. Legal cargo height ~8'6" (13'6" minus the 5' deck).

trailerTypes.name: 48' Step-Deck
trailerTypes.description: Lower main deck: ~10' legal cargo height. Modelled as one deck at the main-deck height.

trailerTypes.name: 48' Conestoga
trailerTypes.description: Flatbed with a rolling tarp system: loads like a flatbed, freight must fit under the tarp.

trailerTypes.name: Extendable Step-Deck
trailerTypes.description: Telescoping step-deck (48' to ~78') for long pieces. Extended beyond 53' it needs a length permit.

trailerTypes.name: Double-Drop / Lowboy
trailerTypes.description: Low well (~29') for tall / heavy equipment: the most legal cargo height (~11'8").

trailerTypes.name: RGN, 3-axle
trailerTypes.description: Removable gooseneck for drive-on equipment, tridem trailer axles (~42,000 lb group).
